title: Study List
purpose: Show all studies with their DistortionType badge and AllocationDistortion magnitude so a user can immediately see which studies exhibit the paradox and how severely.
key_fields: Title, DistortionType (from TreatmentRankings), AllocationDistortion, PolicyImplication, IsSignFlip, TotalCases
user_action: Click a study row to navigate to the Study Detail screen.
name: screen-01-study-list

title: Study Detail
purpose: Show one study's complete geometry: pooled rates, per-stratum rates, allocation fractions, AllocationDistortion, DistortionType, and PolicyImplication — the full causal picture for this study.
key_fields: PooledRateA, PooledRateB, PooledWinner, PerStratumWinner, IsReversal, IsSignFlip, WeightedStratumGapSum, SignedPooledGap, AllocationDistortion, DistortionType, PolicyImplication, ConfoundersInStudy, IsParadoxExplained
user_action: Expand strata panel to see per-stratum breakdown; navigate to Strata Detail.
name: screen-02-study-detail

title: Strata Detail
purpose: Show every (stratum, treatment) cell for a study: StratumSuccessRate, AllocationBias, StratumGap, WeightedStratumGap — the leaf-level evidence for why the pooled conclusion is or isn't misleading.
key_fields: StratumLabel, TreatmentLabel, StratumSuccessRate, StratumRateA, StratumRateB, StratumWinner, AllocationBias, AllocationFractionA, AllocationFractionB, StratumGap, WeightedStratumGap, StratumFraction
user_action: Hover a cell for the raw Successes/Cases count from CaseCells.
name: screen-03-strata-detail

title: Confounder Panel
purpose: Show the stratifying variable's causal role for a study: VariableName, CausalRole, AffectsTreatmentAssignment, AffectsOutcome, IsConfounder, MechanismNote.
key_fields: VariableName, CausalRole, AffectsTreatmentAssignment, AffectsOutcome, IsConfounder, MechanismNote
user_action: Read the mechanism note; understand why IsParadoxExplained is TRUE or FALSE for this study.
name: screen-04-confounder-panel

title: Distortion Plane
purpose: Plot all studies on a 2D plane: AllocationDistortion (x-axis) × ReversalIntensity (y-axis), colored by DistortionType. Shows the geometric taxonomy at a glance and reveals how the four types partition the plane.
key_fields: Title (from Studies), AllocationDistortion, ReversalIntensity, IsSignFlip, DistortionType, PolicyImplication, ParadoxStrength
user_action: Click a data point to navigate to that study's Study Detail screen.
name: screen-05-distortion-plane

title: Model Summary
purpose: Show the instrument's self-portrait: how many studies, how many of each DistortionType, average AllocationDistortion, total paradox strength — the epistemic coverage of the full model instance.
key_fields: StudyCount, ReversalCount, ExplainedCount, TypeACount, TypeBCount, TypeCCount, TypeDCount, AvgAllocationDistortion, TotalParadoxStrength
user_action: Navigate to Study List or Distortion Plane from this summary.
name: screen-06-model-summary

title: Loop History
purpose: Show the full build history: all 31 loops with their status, new concept, domain question, and mock data note. Lets a developer understand why the model is shaped the way it is — the DAG is the story.
key_fields: LoopId, Title, Status, NewConcept, DomainQuestion, MockDataNote, NextSuggestion
user_action: Filter by Status (complete/planned); click a loop to expand its full detail.
name: screen-07-loop-history

title: Methodology
purpose: Show the ten first-principles methodological axioms that shaped this model — from CMCC as the floor, through DAG-first decomposition, to the four-type taxonomy. Enables a developer to apply the same process to a new domain.
user_action: Click IllustratedByLoop to jump to that loop in the Loop History screen.
name: screen-08-methodology

title: Conclusions
purpose: Show all witnessed and planned conclusions, grouped by category (domain / instrument / methodology / open-question). The read-out of what this model has actually established.
key_fields: Category, Status, Title, Evidence, WitnessedInLoop, TargetLoop
user_action: Filter by Status (witnessed/planned/open); click WitnessedInLoop to navigate to Loop History.
name: screen-09-conclusions

title: Discovery Research
purpose: Show pre-registered DiscoveryHypotheses and witnessed DiscoveryFindings — loop-61 corpus patterns and loop-62 causal-role × manifest/latent sweep with study-level breakdown by StratumCausalRole.
key_fields: HypothesisId, HypothesisStatement, ObservedMetric, IsConfirmed, Evidence, WitnessedInLoop
user_action: Review PASS/FAIL cards; filter by RegisteredInLoop; drill into studies by causal role and flip mode.
name: screen-10-discovery
